consequence.statement: Duplicate logs from docker containers that occurred in earlier versions no longer appear after upgrading to 3.0.0.

original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 fixes a bug that caused duplicate logs from docker containers.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, the duplicate logs from docker containers fixed in 3.0.0 no longer appear. The changelog states no failure, rejected setting or required operator step.

corrected.statement: Loki 3.0.0 fixes a bug that produced duplicate logs from docker containers; the changelog states no operator action or other operational impact.

decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line Bug Fixes changelog entry, "Fix duplicate logs from docker containers" [ev-68a10264f91d]. Nothing in the entry or the rest of the section says what an operator must check, what behaviour they rely on changes, or what breaks. Its only stated effect is that a defect is removed. A medium-severity behavior-change that needs review claims more than the text supports, so the consequence is better recorded as none (informational) at low severity.
